system.description: You emit a ray of intense cold at a foe within short range. If it hits, it inflicts 4 damage from cold. Instead of attacking with a ray, you can increase the intensity of the cold that Ice Armor has on your hands, adding 2 damage to your cold touch and to your melee and ranged weapon damage. This aspect of this ability lasts until you use a  ten-minute or longer recovery. Action; action to initiate more intense cold.
